category_title: Highly resistant students with autism and severe communication impairment
minimal_context: Hannah and the tutor are in an individual work session where the goal is to match words to pictures.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our individual work session. Let's match these words to the pictures.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes away from the table and puts her head down, withdrawing from the activity.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit up and look at the materials.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes loud incessant vocalisations and takes the picture cards for herself, not allowing guidance.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let me show you how to match them. Give me the cards.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the materials away, makes loud vocalisations, and begins kicking and hitting the tutor to resist the adult-set agenda.)

STUDENT: (Pushes the materials away, makes loud vocalisations, and begins kicking and hitting the tutor to resist the adult-set agenda.)
